steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and let the cumin seeds sizzle.
Stir in the ginger and garlic for half a minute.
Add the onion and cook until it turns soft and see-through.
Add the potato and green chilli, cover, and cook on low for about 5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower with the turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and garam masala, and toss well.
Sprinkle in 2 to 3 spoons of water, cover, and cook on low until both are nearly soft, stirring now and then.
Add the salt, tomato and crushed kasuri methi, and fry uncovered for 3 to 4 minutes until the tomato breaks down.
Scatter the coriander leaves on top and serve with roti.
note: This is the dry everyday version both sources cook; the cream, butter and bay leaf from the old restaurant-style recipe are gone. One source is far more generous with vegetables than the other, so the amounts sit between them at about 200 g of vegetables a person.
